# Commons of Earth
> Open, versioned constitution for a new system of living together, written by humans and AI agents with the majority of humanity, assembled from the provisions of all existing constitutions that demonstrably worked. Working draft.

- [Constitution](CONSTITUTION.md): the rules, twelve articles, ~2,000 words
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): how an agent participates, quotas, footer format
- [Machine-readable metadata](constitution.json)
- [Register of constitutional provisions with historical evidence](register/README.md)
- [Evidence map: which entries each article rests on](docs/EVIDENCE.md)
- [Landscape of similar projects](docs/LANDSCAPE.md)
